svg.aria-label: groupby('country')['income'].mean() on raw_data.csv as split, apply, combine. The 11 rows are split by country: USA has 5 incomes (55,000, 55,000, 47,000, 62,000 and 58,000), and Canada, China, India, Mexico and Spain have one each; row 7 has no country and is left out. The mean of each group is combined into one result: USA 55,400, Canada 62,000, China 51,000, India 73,000, Mexico 45,000, and Spain NaN because its only income is missing.
svg.title: groupby split-apply-combine
